description: TRI: Query Toxic Release Inventory annual chemical release data for a specific facility. Returns per-chemical release records with chemical name, TRI chemical ID and CAS number, reporting year, on-site releases by medium (air, water, land, underground injection) and their total, and the Form R one-time release quantity, newest reporting year first; page through them with offset and nextOffset. Quantities are in pounds; dioxin and dioxin-like compounds, which TRI has facilities report in grams, are converted and marked with reportedUnit. TRI data lags ~18 months — the most recent available year is typically 2 years prior to the current calendar year. facility_id is the 15-character TRI facility ID: take it from the facilityId field of epa_tri_search_releases, or from the triFacilityIds of epa_echo_get_facility for a facility you already hold a Registry ID for. A 12-digit EPA Registry ID is a different identifier and fails validation.

chemical_id.description: TRI chemical ID to match exactly, where chemical_name matches any name containing its text: a CAS Registry Number, hyphens and leading zeros optional, with a valid check digit; a TRI category code, N and three digits in any case; or a chemicalId an earlier result returned.

chemical_name.description: Optional filter to restrict results to a specific chemical (partial match, case-insensitive). Commas, apostrophes, brackets, and Greek letters are matched as written, e.g. "4,4'-Methylenedianiline".

facility_id.description: 15-character TRI facility ID (e.g. "9867WSNRWD1981S") — the facilityId field returned by epa_tri_search_releases, or an entry of epa_echo_get_facility triFacilityIds. Case, surrounding whitespace, and end slashes are ignored; a 12-digit EPA Registry ID fails validation.

limit.description: Number of filings to return in one call. Default 25; a larger value returns at most 699 and says so. Page past it with offset and nextOffset.

offset.description: Number of filings to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's nextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

year.description: Reporting year to retrieve. Omit for all available years, newest first. TRI data is typically available through ~2 years prior to the current year.

name: epa_tri_get_facility_releases

cap.description: Requested limit after the cap; present only when truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unmatchable_filter`: chemical_name has no letter or digit. `filter_too_long`: chemical_name makes the request too long. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facilityId.description: ID queried, uppercased, without whitespace or slashes

guidance.description: Present when truncated: the continuing offset.

limitNotice.description: Present when a smaller limit than requested applied; says why.

message.description: Recovery hint on an empty result; absent otherwise.

nextOffset.description: Next offset; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Present when a punctuated chemical_name filter hit its read limit first, so more matches may exist.

casNumber.description: CAS Registry Number, hyphenated. Absent for a category code or placeholder.

chemicalId.description: TRI chemical ID (a 10-digit zero-padded CAS number, an N-prefixed category code, or a placeholder); pass it as chemical_id for an exact match. Absent when TRI records none.

oneTimeReleaseInLbs.description: Form R Section 8.8 one-time release quantity in pounds; already counted in the per-medium releases and off-site transfers, so never added to them.

releasesToAirInLbs.description: On-site fugitive + stack air, in pounds

releasesToUndergroundInjectionInLbs.description: On-site injection wells, all classes, in pounds

reportedUnit.description: "grams" when TRI has the chemical reported in grams (dioxin and dioxin-like compounds); quantities here are converted to pounds (1 lb = 453.59237 g). Absent otherwise.

totalOnSiteReleasesInLbs.description: Sum of the per-medium fields present, in pounds; absent when none has a quantity. Media reported only as a range code are left out; TRI's published total counts their midpoint, so it can be higher.

truncated.description: True when more filings may follow; absent on the last page.

title: Get TRI Chemical Releases for Facility
